sentences.ar: القطة كانت تاكل منهم كل يوم.
sentences.en: The cat was eating them every day.

sentences.ar: فار زغير قال: نحط جرس عليها.
sentences.en: A small mouse said: let us put a bell on her.
They all clapped and liked the idea.

sentences.ar: فار كبير سأل: مين بيحط الجرس؟
sentences.en: An old mouse asked: who puts the bell on?
The idea is easy and the doing is hard.
